unresolved_leads.name: mp3-duration
unresolved_leads.reason: Pinned from_read(&mut Cursor<&[u8]>) frame-header scanner. Both untagged CBR controls give 287,346,928 and 313,469,376 ns, equal to the independent header walk (frames x per-frame ns); the API exposes no frame count. Own header-walker family; 122 own source lines; scoped AFL++ maps byte-identical over 5 processes, 1 tuple unique to each control. Recorded in parsers.json and projects/mp3/rust/mp3_duration.
